keySentence: Her friends each needed something inside.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The Wizard told them a secret. They already had what they needed. They just did not know it. Her friends each needed something inside.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The Wizard shared an important secret with each friend. Scarecrow had been smart the whole time on their journey. Tin Man had shown a warm heart by caring for others. Her friends each needed something inside that they already had. Lion had been brave whenever his friends were in danger. They just needed someone to tell them the truth.
